description: Assign a permission set to ONE person (user_id), a ROLE (role) or an AGENT (agent_id), or remove it (remove=true). A person with own sets gets only those — the role's sets no longer apply to them. An agent's sets apply to EVERY call the agent makes, on top of the person's (strictest wins) — so work handed to an agent via delegate_task cannot escape the lock. Admins only.

remove.description: true removes the assignment instead of adding it

role.description: Role to assign the set to (instead of user_id or agent_id)

name: assign_permission_set
